job.person_note: The presenter must be exactly the person from the second attached photo.
job.style: A finished, eye-catching video COVER (YouTube/Reels thumbnail) for an example video of an AI video production service, built EXACTLY in the design system «Премиальный корпоративный» from the FIRST attached board: ivory #F6F1E7, graphite #2B2D33, muted gold #B8935A, deep bordeaux #6E1F2B; elegant Playfair Display-like serif headlines, thin gold hairlines and corner ticks. The presenter is the CEO woman from the SECOND attached photo (same face, dark hair in a low bun, bordeaux blazer) — photorealistic, the same person, cut out and integrated into the graphic design. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text on the cover: a small pill label «Локализация» and a big title in two lines «Одно обращение —» / «три языка». No other words, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements. High contrast, readable at small size, modern and premium.
job.style_qa: обложка ролика в стиле приложенного борда, ведущий из приложенного фото узнаваем и не искажён, надписи «Локализация» и Одно обращение — три языка без ошибок, другого текста нет
job.prompt: Vertical layout: the pill label and the title in the top third, the key visual in the middle, the presenter waist-up in the lower half; keep ALL text inside the central 84% of the WIDTH. Key visual: a dotted gold world map with Moscow, London and Madrid markers and three language chips «RU», «EN», «ES».
